name: Lokkestiiz

abilities.name: Shatter
abilities.description: The Frozen Tomb shatters if a player does not stand in it, causing massive damage to the entire group.

abilities.name: Frigid Cold
abilities.description: Lokkestiiz has an aura of cold energy around him. When you are close to him, it causes damage.

abilities.name: Frost Breath
abilities.description: Lokkestiiz breathes a blast of frost, indicated by a massive conical AoE.

abilities.name: Storm Fury
abilities.description: Lokkestiiz fires off a beam of lightning during flight.

abilities.name: Wing Thrash
abilities.description: Lokkestiiz hits you with his wing if you're too close.

abilities.name: Aerial Onslaught
abilities.description: At 80%/50%/20% health, Lokkestiiz flies into the air and ceases to be targetable. A large amount of atronachs are summoned into the arena at the same time. From here, Lokkestiiz will perform a strafing run over the arena, breathing electricity that will linger for a time, dealing damage if touched, and will end by performing a massive ice and shock beam that sweeps across the arena, and must be blocked to avoid the immense damage it deals.

abilities.name: Summon Frost Atronach
abilities.description: Summons a Frost Atronach with 3,408,25819,405,160 health.

abilities.name: Glacial Fist
abilities.description: Very powerful blow from Lokkestiiz's Frost Atronachs which can easily one shot most players. Indicated by a conical aoe.

abilities.name: Summon Storm Atronach
abilities.description: Summons a Storm Atronach with 321,8912,874,839 health.

abilities.name: Meteor
abilities.description: The Storm Atronach enters the arena, causing damage if a player is under it when it spawns. Can be blocked.

abilities.name: Unstable Explosion
abilities.description: The Storm Atronach enters execute phase similar to Stormfist. The atronach must be burned down.

abilities.name: Storm Bound
abilities.description: Lightning-based attack from the Storm Atronach.

notes: His name translates to "Sky Tempest Ice" in the Dragon Language.
related_quests: The Return of Alkosh: Defeat the Alkosh pretender and liberate the faithful of Sunspire.
summary: Lokkestiiz is a frost dragon residing in the Sunspire, masquerading as an aspect of Jone. Lokkestiiz is known for his freezing breath.
